method: GitHub REST Git refs collection, 100 refs/page, pages 1-8, all returned tip SHAs and ref types; duplicate names rejected, terminal empty page 8 checked.
limitations: This lists refs visible to current GitHub credential and endpoint at collection time. It does not enumerate every object reachable beneath each ref, hidden server refs, deleted refs, unreachable objects, or historic revisions; no object content was rehashed here.
